questions.q: Which liberator is called the father of Chile?
questions.why: He was Chile's first head of state.

questions.q: In which year did Chile declare independence?
questions.why: It was declared on 12 February 1818.

questions.q: Which general ruled Chile as dictator from 1973 to 1990?
questions.why: He took power in a coup.

questions.q: Which President died during the 1973 coup?
questions.why: He was the first elected Marxist President in Latin America.

questions.q: Which Chilean poet won the 1971 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: He wrote 'Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair'.

questions.q: Which Chilean poet was the first Latin American to win the Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: She won in 1945.

questions.q: Who became Chile's first woman President, in 2006?
questions.why: She served two terms.

questions.q: Which 1879–84 war won Chile its northern deserts?
questions.why: It was fought against Peru and Bolivia.

questions.q: Which Indigenous people resisted Spanish conquest in the south for centuries?
questions.why: Their resistance is called the Arauco War.

questions.q: Which Spanish conquistador founded Santiago in 1541?
questions.why: He was later killed by the Mapuche.

questions.q: Which 1988 vote ended Pinochet's rule?
questions.why: The 'No' campaign won.

questions.q: Which earthquake of 1960 was the strongest ever recorded?
questions.why: It measured 9.5.

questions.q: Which naval hero died boarding an enemy ship at Iquique in 1879?
questions.why: 21 May is Navy Day.

questions.q: Which Chilean author wrote 'The House of the Spirits'?
questions.why: She is a relative of Salvador Allende.

questions.q: Which 2010 rescue saved 33 miners trapped underground?
questions.why: They were trapped for 69 days.

questions.q: What is the capital of Chile?
questions.why: It lies below the Andes.

questions.q: Which island has giant stone heads called moai?
questions.why: It belongs to Chile.

questions.q: Which desert in northern Chile is the driest non-polar place on Earth?
questions.why: Some areas have never recorded rain.

questions.q: Which mountain range runs along Chile's eastern border?
questions.why: It includes Ojos del Salado.

questions.q: What is Chile's currency?
questions.why: Its code is CLP.

questions.q: What shape is Chile famous for?
questions.why: It is about 4,300 km long.

questions.q: Which metal is Chile the world's top producer of?
questions.why: Chuquicamata is one of the biggest open-pit mines.

questions.q: Which national park in Patagonia is famous for granite towers?
questions.why: Its name means 'towers of blue'.

questions.q: Which colourful port city is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is built on steep hills with funiculars.

questions.q: Which grape brandy does Chile share as a national drink with Peru?
questions.why: Both countries claim it.

questions.q: Which island in the south is known for wooden churches?
questions.why: Its churches are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which baked pastries filled with beef and onion are popular?
questions.why: They are eaten on Independence Day.

questions.q: Which telescope array in the Atacama is one of the world's largest?
questions.why: It studies the universe in radio waves.

questions.q: What is Chile's national dance?
questions.why: Dancers wave handkerchiefs.

questions.q: Which archipelago is home to 'Robinson Crusoe Island'?
questions.why: A sailor stranded there inspired the novel.
